name: Adobe Campaign
description: Adobe Campaign is an enterprise cross-channel campaign management platform for profiles, audiences, subscriptions, workflows, deliveries, transactional messaging, privacy operations, and marketing history.
agentUseSummary: Adobe Campaign spans Standard REST APIs and deployment-dependent Campaign v8/Classic API models with materially different authentication, data, and lifecycle contracts. Relay mounts no connection or tools until one generation, deployment, bounded resource, and service-to-service permission model are selected.

blocked.label: Connect Adobe Campaign
blocked.description: Relay has not selected a Campaign generation, deployment model, tenant authority, and bounded API resource.

blocked.label: Read Campaign data
blocked.description: Profiles, services, subscriptions, custom resources, workflows, deliveries, history, audiences, and privacy data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change Adobe Campaign
blocked.description: Profile changes, subscriptions, workflow control, deliveries, transactional messages, privacy requests, imports, exports, and every mutation are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled until one Campaign generation and bounded API/data contract are reviewed.

runtimeSupport.description: No Campaign tools are mounted without a selected generation, deployment, and bounded data contract.
No Campaign tools are mounted without a selected generation, deployment, and bounded data contract.

providerSetup.blocker: The generic Adobe Campaign candidate does not identify Campaign Standard versus Campaign v8/Classic, the v8 deployment model, or one bounded resource. These variants expose different REST, JavaScript, and SOAP surfaces and can include profiles, marketing history, workflows, transactional messaging, deliveries, and privacy operations.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Adobe Campaign unavailable until Relay selects one supported Campaign generation and deployment, chooses a narrowly useful resource, documents the Adobe organization and service-to-service identity contract, defines field minimization and retention, and validates permission removal, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Adobe documents deployment-dependent Campaign v8 APIs, JavaScript and SOAP concepts, IMS changes, dual-database behavior, and API throughput limits.
Adobe documents Adobe I/O OAuth server-to-server setup for Campaign REST access and required authorization and API-key headers.
Adobe documents Campaign Standard REST planes for profiles, services, custom resources, workflows, privacy, transactional messaging, and marketing history.
Adobe documents high-impact workflow start, pause, resume, and stop mutations, which Relay blocks.
